# Pinned refactoring tool dependencies for supply-chain security
# This file pins exact versions to prevent supply-chain attacks during CI workflows
# Used by: jules-deep-refactor.yml
# Last updated: 2024-01-15
# Python version: 3.11+
#
# SECURITY NOTE: These tools are installed in a workflow with contents:write permission.
# Exact version pinning prevents malicious package releases from executing arbitrary code
# during pip install and potentially compromising the repository.
#
# To update versions:
#   1. Review the changelog and code changes for the new version
#   2. Test the new version in a non-production environment
#   3. Update the version pin below
#   4. Optionally add SHA256 hashes for additional integrity verification:
#      pip download --no-deps <package>==<version>
#      sha256sum <downloaded-file>
#
# For hash-based verification, use: pip install --require-hashes -r refactor-requirements.txt

# Ruff - Fast Python linter (used in jules-deep-refactor.yml)
# Pinned to specific version to prevent supply-chain attacks
ruff==0.8.4

# Bandit - Security linter (used in jules-deep-refactor.yml)  
# Pinned to specific version to prevent supply-chain attacks
bandit==1.8.0

# Bandit transitive dependencies (pinned to prevent dependency confusion attacks)
# These are required by bandit and must be pinned to prevent malicious versions
# from being selected during dependency resolution

stevedore==5.3.0
pbr==6.1.0
